html:
Date night, upgraded. Join Surround Society and BUZZY on Friday, October 16 for a one-hour reset built for two, with snacks, sips, a guided sound experience, and a special BUZZY treat.

What to expect

  • A warm welcome with drinks, tea, and canapés
  • Guided breathwork and an energy reset with Deena
  • A live sound bath with Linsey
  • A short guided close to share with your person
  • A few goodies from BUZZY to take with you

Bring your partner, your best friend, whoever. No experience needed. Wear something comfy and Surround Society has the rest covered.

Details

  • When: Friday, October 16, 7:00 to 8:00 pm
  • Where: Surround Society, 220 Atlantic Ave, Brooklyn, just down the street from the shop
  • Tickets: $111 per pair
  • Space: Only 10 couples

Reserve your spot at Surround Society →

Open to adults 21+ with valid ID.
